apiKey.title: Ticketmaster API Key
apiKey.description: Your Ticketmaster Discovery API key. Get it from https://developer.ticketmaster.com/

startDate.title: Start Date
startDate.description: Optional start date in format YYYY-MM-DD. Default: first day of previous month (e.g., if today is January 2025, default is "2025-12-01")

endDate.title: End Date
endDate.description: Optional end date in format YYYY-MM-DD. Default: last day of next month (e.g., if today is January 2025, default is "2026-02-28")

maxPages.title: Max Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of pages to paginate (default: 5, max: 20). API supports up to 1000 items (size * page < 1000)

pageSize.title: Page Size
pageSize.description: Number of events per page (default: 20, max: 200)
